result: The full rational subgroup is the compact fibre of Frobenius-minus-identity, but each parity half has size (n-1)/2 and is neither a subgroup nor a coset in the prime-order group. Full isogeny norms and subgroup-norm towers cannot select the ordered half-orbit branch.
claim_boundary: No lower bound for unrestricted incomplete products, resultants, elliptic nets, arithmetic circuits, or ECDLP is claimed.
